name: Gionni Lewis
strengths: Lewis stacks defensive backs vertically as #1 outside — sudden release into a true go gear with clean over-the-shoulder tracking (freshman Hudl).
Lewis wins after the catch with twitchy lateral cuts on screens and breakaway juice on in-breaking routes taken the distance.
Lewis plucks away from his frame — including a one-handed behind-the-body grab in stride — and high-points in traffic near the goal line; also shows house-call vision as a punt returner.
weaknesses: Lewis is still a lean 6-0 / 175 freshman mold — needs functional mass and a more varied release package vs physical press before every-down SEC snaps.
comparison: Lewis comps to Jordan Addison — listed 6-0 / 175 vs Addison's ~5-11 / 175 sudden WR mold (height within ~1", same lean skill frame); then matching vertical stack, tracking hands, and twitchy YAC from Lewis's freshman tape (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Lewis projects as a Year-1 scout-team / developmental perimeter WR, Year 2–3 compete for rotational snaps, with every-down Z/slot WR upside if the 6-0 / 175 frame fills and the release package holds vs press.
schemeFit: Lewis fits a multiple WR package that can park a lean separator outside as Z or flexed in the slot while he adds mass — vertical threat + YAC after the catch.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-25 from Hudl freshman season (45 Rec / 832 Yds / 8 TD title card). Comp size-matched to Jordan Addison band. Cleared provisional after tape review.
recruitingStory: Gionni Lewis is a 2028 Booker T. Washington (Pensacola, FL) ATH/WR · listed 6-0 / 175 · freshman production 45-832-8 · Florida offered with a 2025-06-03 UOV — Florida leads On3 RPM (~73%) with Troy ~6% and Florida State ~5%.
angle: Pensacola ATH with freshman tape that stacks vertical juice + YAC — Florida already clear atop On3 RPM with offer + UOV on file.
insiderNotes: Lewis is a lean #1 outside separator on freshman tape: vertical stack, tracking hands (incl. one-handed grab), twitchy YAC, and return-game juice. Florida leads On3 RPM ~73% with offer + June 2025 UOV.
